text: Subject: Notification of loss. I hereby inform you that on Thursday at 18:10 I was stopped at a red light on Avenida da Liberdade in Lisbon, in steady rain, when the vehicle behind me failed to brake and struck my rear. My grey Renault Clio (2017) has a pushed-in boot lid and a broken tail light, but remains roadworthy. The other driver admitted at the scene that he was looking at his phone. Details were exchanged and photographs taken. Kindly confirm receipt of this notification.

Morning all, silly one. About 8:05 I was reversing out of my drive in Manchester and tapped the neighbour's bin lorry mirror, my fault completely, wasn't looking. Only a scuff on my red bumper, the lorry has a bent mirror arm. Do I need to report it before the weekend?

I don't even know where to start, I'm still shaking. It was about 6:50 this morning on I-25 just north of Denver and the fog was like a wall, I could not see two car lengths. Someone ahead stopped dead, I braked, my black Ford F-150 (2020) slid and hit the SUV in front, and then a truck hit me from behind and then I heard more bangs behind that, I think at least six or seven vehicles in total. Airbags went off, the hood is folded up, the radiator is leaking everywhere and the door on my side will not open, firefighters had to cut me out. Paramedics checked me, mostly my chest and wrist hurt. The state trooper said the whole thing is still being sorted, nobody can say who hit whom first because of the fog and the pile of cars, so I honestly do not know whose fault it is. Мне очень страшно, пожалуйста, перезвоните как можно скорее. My wife has the policy papers. Please call me, I am at the hospital.

Delivery stop in the pedestrian zone near the Main Square in Krakow, 13:30, overcast. I was creeping along the walkway in my white Volkswagen Golf 2012 with a permit and clipped a metal cafe sign and a bollard. Nobody was walking right there, a couple of tourists got a fright. Scratches along the left side. I take the blame, I was too close to the stalls.

some jerk hit my blue hyundai in the supermarket lot around 8pm tonite and drove off, no note nothing. long scrape on the rear door, paint gone. its dry and clear so the camera by the entrance should have it. can u pull the footage? ugh

Around 3:20 in the afternoon on the Gardiner in Toronto. The pavement was still wet from the morning shower. I signalled and started moving over into the middle lane in my silver Honda Civic 2016 and a white pickup that was in my blind spot came up at the same moment and we sideswiped each other. Both of us say the other one should have looked, to be honest I think we share it, I did not check my mirror twice and he was speeding up. Dents and scratched paint down the whole driver side, the mirror hangs by its cable.

This is the third time I am writing and nobody answers. Last Saturday at 11:10 at night, in the middle of a heavy rain, I was crossing the intersection at Aurora and 85th in Seattle on a green light in my green Subaru Outback 2018 when a pickup flew through his red and hit the whole passenger side. He did not even slow down, I have the dashcam and the witness statement of the bus driver who was waiting at the stop. The side of my car is caved in up to the middle pillar, both airbags on that side went off, the wheel is bent out and the car was towed from the scene on a flatbed. I had a concussion and three days in the hospital. הוא עבר באדום, ברור לגמרי. The police report names him as the one who ran the light, so this is entirely his fault and I expect a full repair or a total loss payout without more games, I am not paying for his mistake. Please assign a human adjuster.

Please help, accident at the junction outside Marseille this morning around 6:30, thick fog, I turned left onto the road and a car came out of the mist head on, we hit each other in the middle. My Peugeot 208 from 2022 has the whole front destroyed. Je ne sais pas qui avait la priorité, he says I turned too early and I say he was too fast. Police are still investigating so nobody knows who is to blame yet. I have a sore neck.

1:40 am, clear night, Austin, I was coming home from a late shift in my white Tesla 2021 and braked quite hard for a cat, the guy behind tapped my bumper. He was too close but I also stopped very suddenly, so we agreed it is a bit on both of us. Tiny crack in my plastic bumper cover.

Incident report. Date: weekday, time: 14:05. Location: loading dock behind a shop in Rotterdam. Weather: overcast. A delivery truck reversed without a spotter and pushed into the front-left of my parked orange Mazda 2015 model. Driver of the truck acknowledged the manoeuvre and gave his company details. Damage: crumpled wing, broken headlight, bonnet no longer closes properly. Truck driver solely responsible. Vehicle drivable at low speed. Photos attached.

so i came out of the garage around 7:30pm and my nissan 2019 had a deep scrape and a dent on the back corner, ground was all wet and puddles everywhere. dont know when it happened, could be me when i parked this morning in the tight spot or someone else in the lot, nobody left a note. الله يستر. Cant say whose fault. what do i do

Sorry, it was me. 8:45, Glasgow, driving rain, I was late, I did not stop in time in my maroon Vauxhall Astra 2013 and shunted the car in front into the one ahead of it. Three cars involved. Mine is dented at the front.
